name: Pendant with the Virgin of the Immaculate Conception, first third of the 17th century
note: Gold, enamel and pearls; H. 10.2 cm, W. 6 cm. Spain, first third of the 17th century. The Virgin is shown standing on a crescent moon within a rayed, pearl-set oval.
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Robert Lehman Collection, 1975 (1975.1.1515)
